g.desc: Trigger path: TRIG_IN -> U702 (SN74LVC1G125, ~{OE} pin 1 grounded, so always enabled) -> L3_DRV -> R704 (220 ohm) -> L3 -> camera

g.desc: L1: Camera pin 4, Line 1 OPTOOUT, pulled up to +3.3V by R702 (4.7 k), into Schmitt 2A, clamped by U705.

g.text: CAM_OUT: Buffered Line 2 (exposure active) from U701A 1Y; drives the BNC resistor, the LED resistor and the OUT tap.

g.desc: CAM_OUT: Buffered Line 2 (exposure active) from U701A 1Y; drives the BNC resistor, the LED resistor and the OUT tap.

g.text: 100 ohm tap (R709) on L2, camera Line 2, the open-drain exposure output.

g.desc: 100 ohm tap (R709) on L2, camera Line 2, the open-drain exposure output.

g.text: 100 ohm tap (R708) on L1_BUF, camera Line 1 OPTOOUT after the Schmitt buffer.

g.text: L3_DRV: U702 Y, the trigger drive before the 220 ohm series resistor.

g.text: L1_BUF: Schmitt 2Y: buffered Line 1 for the L1_INST tap.

g.desc: L1_BUF: Schmitt 2Y: buffered Line 1 for the L1_INST tap.

g.text: PLACE: Place U702 near J701 pin 1 with C701 at its pin 6 and a short return to pin 3; R704 between the driver and the connector.

g.desc: PLACE: Place U702 near J701 pin 1 with C701 at its pin 6 and a short return to pin 3; R704 between the driver and the connector.

g.text: 100 ohm series taps: R710 on L3, R707 on L0, R709 on L2, R708 on L1_BUF, R711 on CAM_OUT, each to its _INST port.

g.desc: 100 ohm series taps: R710 on L3, R707 on L0, R709 on L2, R708 on L1_BUF, R711 on CAM_OUT, each to its _INST port.

g.text: 4. Exposure output, BNC drive and LED

g.desc: 4. Exposure output, BNC drive and LED

g.text: PLACE: Place the five taps as a row toward the instrument-port side of the block.

g.desc: PLACE: Place the five taps as a row toward the instrument-port side of the block.

g.text: U702 (always enabled) drives L3_DRV; R704 (220 ohm) in series feeds camera Line 3 on L3; C701 bypasses U702's VCC.

g.desc: U702 (always enabled) drives L3_DRV; R704 (220 ohm) in series feeds camera Line 3 on L3; C701 bypasses U702's VCC.

g.text: ROUTE: INSTRUMENT class to the instrument port; every tapped node has a DC definition (driven or pulled up).

g.desc: ROUTE: INSTRUMENT class to the instrument port; every tapped node has a DC definition (driven or pulled up).

g.text: ROUTE: L3 is a 3.3 V edge-triggered line: short, over ground, away from the switching parts of the board.

g.desc: ROUTE: L3 is a 3.3 V edge-triggered line: short, over ground, away from the switching parts of the board.

g.text: Unit 1: Schmitt buffers, L2 and L1

g.desc: Unit 1: Schmitt buffers, L2 and L1

g.text: PLACE: Place both arrays right at J701's pads, before any series part, with the shortest GND return.

g.desc: PLACE: Place both arrays right at J701's pads, before any series part, with the shortest GND return.

g.text: ROUTE: Wire the paired I/O pads together on the node itself; no separate track between them.

g.desc: ROUTE: Wire the paired I/O pads together on the node itself; no separate track between them.

g.text: U704 clamps L3 and L0, U705 clamps L2 and L1, both referenced to +5V and GND; each pair's two I/O pins are tied to the node.

g.desc: U704 clamps L3 and L0, U705 clamps L2 and L1, both referenced to +5V and GND; each pair's two I/O pins are tied to the node.

g.text: Matching net labels are connected. Group order explains function; PCB placement priorities are stated below.

g.desc: Matching net labels are connected. Group order explains function; PCB placement priorities are stated below.

g.text: ROUTE: L3, L0, L2 and L1 run straight from the pads to their clamps and parts; GND from pins 5 and 6 into the block's return.

g.desc: ROUTE: L3, L0, L2 and L1 run straight from the pads to their clamps and parts; GND from pins 5 and 6 into the block's return.

g.text: Blackfly S GPIO channel | trigger in, sync in, exposure out, five taps; vertical or horizontal header

g.desc: Blackfly S GPIO channel | trigger in, sync in, exposure out, five taps; vertical or horizontal header

g.text: J701, the 6-position 3.5 mm Phoenix header; pins 1 to 4 are Lines 3, 0, 2 and 1, pins 5 and 6 are the camera's two grounds.

g.desc: J701, the 6-position 3.5 mm Phoenix header; pins 1 to 4 are Lines 3, 0, 2 and 1, pins 5 and 6 are the camera's two grounds.

g.text: PLACE: Place J701 at the board edge the plug needs: the vertical body takes the plug from above, the horizontal from its +Y side; the anchor is the pad-array centre for both.

g.desc: PLACE: Place J701 at the board edge the plug needs: the vertical body takes the plug from above, the horizontal from its +Y side; the anchor is the pad-array centre for both.

g.text: U703's open-drain Y pulls L0 low; R703 (820 ohm) returns it to +5V, the opto input's drive level; C702 bypasses U703's VCC.

g.desc: U703's open-drain Y pulls L0 low; R703 (820 ohm) returns it to +5V, the opto input's drive level; C702 bypasses U703's VCC.

g.text: PLACE: Place U703 near J701 pin 2 with C702 at its pin 6; R703 from L0 to the +5V entry.

g.desc: PLACE: Place U703 near J701 pin 2 with C702 at its pin 6; R703 from L0 to the +5V entry.

g.text: ROUTE: L0 carries about 6 mA pulses into the camera's opto input; keep its return with the trigger line.

g.desc: ROUTE: L0 carries about 6 mA pulses into the camera's opto input; keep its return with the trigger line.

g.text: ESD: two USBLC6-2P6 arrays with VBUS on +5V clamp L3 and L0 (U704) and L2 and L1 (U705), 15 kV IEC 61000-4-2 level 4, at most 3.5

g.desc: ESD: two USBLC6-2P6 arrays with VBUS on +5V clamp L3 and L0 (U704) and L2 and L1 (U705), 15 kV IEC 61000-4-2 level 4, at most 3.5

g.text: L3: Camera pin 1, Line 3 GPI trigger, driven by U702 through R704 (220 ohm), clamped by U704.

g.desc: L3: Camera pin 1, Line 3 GPI trigger, driven by U702 through R704 (220 ohm), clamped by U704.

g.text: L2: Camera pin 3, Line 2 as open-drain exposure output, pulled up by R701 (1 k), into Schmitt 1A, clamped by U705.

g.desc: L2: Camera pin 3, Line 2 as open-drain exposure output, pulled up by R701 (1 k), into Schmitt 1A, clamped by U705.

g.text: L0: Camera pin 2, Line 0 OPTOIN: open-drain U703 Y, pulled to +5V by R703 (820 ohm), clamped by U704.

g.desc: L0: Camera pin 2, Line 0 OPTOIN: open-drain U703 Y, pulled to +5V by R703 (820 ohm), clamped by U704.

g.text: Logic rail for U701A, U702, U703 and the L2/L1 pull-ups; always-on if the taps must read before firmware.

g.desc: Logic rail for U701A, U702, U703 and the L2/L1 pull-ups; always-on if the taps must read before firmware.

g.text: R701 pulls Line 2 up, U701A gate 1 squares it into CAM_OUT; R705 drives the BNC, R706 lights D701; R702 pulls Line 1 up and gate 2 buffers it into L1_BUF;

g.desc: R701 pulls Line 2 up, U701A gate 1 squares it into CAM_OUT; R705 drives the BNC, R706 lights D701; R702 pulls Line 1 up and gate 2 buffers it into L1_BUF;

g.text: ROUTE: CAM_OUT is the board's exposure reference: route R705's far end to the BNC with a ground return beside it.

g.desc: ROUTE: CAM_OUT is the board's exposure reference: route R705's far end to the BNC with a ground return beside it.

g.text: PLACE: Place U701A between the connector and the BNC side with C703 at its pin 5; R701 and R702 at the connector pads; D701 where it is visible.

g.desc: PLACE: Place U701A between the connector and the BNC side with C703 at its pin 5; R701 and R702 at the connector pads; D701 where it is visible.
